scope: Read-only operational timing, source identity, processes, access counters and resources only. No model/Memory payloads, formal text, labels or effect metrics loaded.

limitations: Operational projection, not a confidence interval or guaranteed upper bound.
Assumes continuous three-slot admission; no extra failures or resource waits.
Missing order/stage timings use same-stage all-order pools; pending GCR uses completed run mean.
Confirmation/analysis adds the prior 2.5-4h proxy; result review excluded.
